flightLabelZh: 实时可售票/票价监控不可用
flightNotes: OpenSky Network ADS-B only (no fares, no bookable inventory). 「实时可售票/票价监控不可用」. flightScheduleConfigured=true means ADS-B is enabled; flightScheduleLive is last successful fetch only (429/404 → false). Set AMADEUS_CLIENT_ID+SECRET for inventory; FLIGHT_OPENSKY=0 to disable ADS-B fallback.
